proof_body:
by
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  have hd : Real.cos x * Real.cos y - Real.sin x * Real.sin y ≠ 0 := by rwa [← Real.cos_add]
  have h1 : 1 - Real.tan x * Real.tan y = (Real.cos x * Real.cos y - Real.sin x * Real.sin y) / (Real.cos x * Real.cos y) := by
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    field_simp
  have h2 : Real.tan x + Real.tan y = (Real.sin x * Real.cos y + Real.cos x * Real.sin y) / (Real.cos x * Real.cos y) := by
    rw [Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos]
    field_simp
  rw [h1, h2, Real.tan_eq_sin_div_cos, Real.sin_add, Real.cos_add]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ x y : ℝ, Real.cos x ≠ 0 → Real.cos y ≠ 0 → Real.cos (x + y) ≠ 0 → Real.tan (x + y) = (Real.tan x + Real.tan y) / (1 - Real.tan x * Real.tan y)
